KINKERSTRAAT for my cat, there is always a tiny little bag of catnip included, which my cat loves and goes wild for. The day before yesterday I bought this tin of catnip at Pets Place in the Kinkerstraat in Amsterdam for 10 EUROS. (I already thought this was ridiculously expensive)
